test_title: PYST 8: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Three workers A, B and C are given a job to make a sofa. At the end of each day, they are given Rs. 650 collectively as wages. If A worked alone, the work would be completed in 5 days. If B worked alone, the work would be completed in 10 days. If C worked alone, the work would be completed in 15 days. Find the individual daily wage of C
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Daily wages are distributed in the ratio of **efficiencies** (work done per day).

Ratio of efficiencies (A : B : C) = 1/5 : 1/10 : 1/15

Multiplying by **LCM(5, 10, 15) = 30** → 6 : 3 : 2

Total efficiency parts = 6 + 3 + 2 = 11

C's daily wage = (2 / 11) × 650 = 1300 / 11 = 118.18

**∴ The correct answer is 118.18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **A** = 5 days

Time taken by **B** = 10 days

Time taken by **C** = 15 days

Total daily wage = **Rs. 650**

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

Individual Wage = (Individual Efficiency ÷ Total Efficiency) × Total Wage
